notes.title: Developer Diary:
notes.content: [list][*][p]The game is entering its final stage of development.[/p][/*][*][p]Localization into several languages has begun.[/p][/*][*][p]The inventory system has been updated compared to the demo version.[/p][/*][*][p]New gameplay features have been added.[/p][/*][*][p]The story of the first chapter has been expanded and deepened.[/p][/*][*][p]An updated demo will be released after the full game's launch.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]
